title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023




**Job Description**

The Manager, Product Engineering for the Suite Experience leads a team of architects and developers focused on modernizing isolved's core HCM user experience by replacing legacy UI patterns with modern, responsive interfaces across its HR, payroll, benefits, and talent products. This role requires a balance of strong people leadership and delivery management, ensuring teams follow effective agile practices through coaching, capacity planning, and accountability for commitments, while also developing talent, addressing skill gaps and performance issues early. Acting as a strategic partner to product management, the manager helps align quarterly commitments with realistic capacity and combines solid technical judgement with leadership expertise in distributed environments to guide architectural decisions, support code quality, remove blockers proactively, use data to assess delivery risks, and translate technical efforts into business value for stakeholders.


**Core Job Duties**

* Drive effective agile execution and continuous improvement by coaching scrum masters and team leads, adapting processes to team needs
* Monitor team health and delivery performance using data, proactively address issues proactively, communicate risks, capacity, and business impact to leadership with transparency and early escalation
* Partner closely with product management on planning and roadmap development, using data to ensure commitments are realistic and aligned with capacity
* Remove blockers proactively, empower teams to resolve issues, and coordinate dependencies across sub\-teams and workstreams
* Developsupport team members through regular 1:1s, targeted coaching, and mentorship to grow technical, leadership, and domain skills, while leading hiring and performance evaluations that foster career development
* Proactively identify and address underperformance using data and observation, following a structured approach to resolution before issues escalate.
* Maintaining technical credibility with the team through engagement in code reviews, architecture discussions, and proof of concept work
* Connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes, explaining tradeoffs between technical excellence and speed to market

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of software development experience
* 4\+ years of engineering management experience, including direct reports and performance management responsibility
* Managing distributed or offshore engineering teams
* Demonstrated experience managing development teams using Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid)
* Strong skills in:
* C\#, .NET, Angular, SQL server
* Experience with:
* Azure cloud services
* CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices
* Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar project management tools
* Code review processes and quality standards
* Angular/React
* HCM, HR tech, or enterprise B2B SaaS

**About isolved**

isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people\-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers \- who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HRpayroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high\-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.




**EEO Statement**

*isolved is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and open\-minded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are.*

**Disability Accommodation**

*Visit* *www.isolvedhcm.com/careers* *for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. Visit* *www.isolvedeebenefits.com* *for a comprehensive list of our employee total rewards offerings.*




Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions outlined above.


In adherence to relevant pay transparency legislation and regulations, we endeavor to offer  

clarity regarding our compensation methodology for this position. While specific pay ranges  

are presently under review to ensure alignment with competitive market standards, we will  

furnish this information upon finalization.  

At our organization, individual compensation structures are established through a consistent  

and equitable process, taking into account various pertinent factors. These factors  

encompass geographic location, job\-specific competencies, educational attainment,  

professional certifications, and pertinent experience. This structured approach enables us to  

align our total rewards package competitively with each employee's qualifications, duties,  

and contributions to our collective success.  

An employee's comprehensive compensation package comprises diverse components, such  

as base salary, performance\-linked bonuses or commissions, long\-term incentives like equity  

grants, and an extensive benefits portfolio. Should you advance as a finalist candidate, you  

will have the opportunity to explore our overarching compensation philosophy, practices,  

and how your unique background informs an appropriate compensation proposition.  

Our commitment lies in fostering a fair, impartial, and transparent compensation framework  

throughout our workforce. All compensation determinations are aimed at justly  

acknowledging and rewarding the value, qualifications, and significant contributions that our  

employees bring to their roles and to the company's achievements. We welcome your  

inquiries about our principles of pay equity, accompanying analyses, and associated  

procedures throughout the recruitment process.

title: Executive Assistant – Technology
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Executive \& Administrative Support**

* Manage highly complex and dynamic executive calendars across multiple time zones, ensuring optimal prioritization of business\-critical activities.
* Coordinate and schedule internal and external meetings, leadership forums, town halls, client engagements, and cross\-functional discussions.
* Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively recommend solutions to maximize executive effectiveness.
* Screen, prioritize, and manage correspondence, meeting requests, and inquiries on behalf of executives.
* Prepare and coordinate briefing materials, agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting documentation for executive meetings.

### **Leadership Operations \& Coordination**

* Support day\-to\-day operations of the Technology Leadership team across India, Hong Kong, and the broader APAC region.
* Track key action items, leadership commitments, and follow\-ups arising from executive meetings and business reviews.
* Coordinate leadership team meetings, off\-sites, planning sessions, and strategic workshops.
* Assist with monitoring organizational priorities, ensuring timely completion of deliverables and stakeholder communications.
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration among Technology, Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, HR, and Vendor Management teams.

### **Communication \& Stakeholder Management**

* Draft, review, and manage executive communications including emails, announcements, presentations, town hall materials, and leadership updates.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for senior leaders, business stakeholders, external partners, and regional teams.
* Build strong relationships across executive offices globally to facilitate efficient coordination and decision\-making.
* Ensure professional handling of sensitive and confidential information.

### **Travel \& Event Management**

* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, visas, transportation, and detailed itineraries.
* Manage travel logistics across India, Hong Kong, and other APAC locations.
* Coordinate leadership visits, executive meetings, conferences, and employee engagement events.
* Support expense management, reconciliation, and submission in accordance with company policies.

### **Meeting \& Governance Support**

* Organize leadership governance meetings and executive review sessions.
* Develop agendas and meeting materials and ensure participants are appropriately prepared.
* Capture key decisions, actions, and follow\-up items where required.
* Maintain records, documentation, and organizational information repositories.

### **Strategic Support**

* Assist executives in managing strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.
* Support preparation of leadership presentations, business reviews, operating reviews, and organizational updates.
* Conduct research and gather information needed to support executive decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, workplace productivity, and executive support practices.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting senior executives, preferably within Technology, Financial Services, Asset Management, or a global corporate environment.
* Proven experience supporting C\-suite leaders, CIOs, CTOs, Engineering Leaders, or equivalent senior executives.
* Strong understanding of global business operations and executive office management.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
------------------------------

### **Executive Support Excellence**

* Advanced calendar and time management
* Executive office administration
* Meeting and event coordination
* Travel management
* Prioritization and organizational skills

### **Communication**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Presentation preparation
* Executive correspondence management
* Stakeholder engagement

### **Business \& Operational Acumen**

* Ability to understand business priorities and executive objectives
* Strong follow\-up and action tracking capabilities
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

### **Technology Skills**

* Microsoft 365 Suite (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Collaboration and productivity platforms
* Expense and travel management systems
* Experience using AI\-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) is preferred

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Highly professional with strong executive presence.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, diplomacy, and discretion.
* Proactive, resourceful, and solution\-oriented.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining a strategic perspective.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities.
* Possesses a strong customer\-service and partnership mindset.

**Success Measures**
--------------------


The Executive Assistant will be successful by:

* Enabling seamless executive operations across India and Hong Kong/APAC.
* Maintaining highly effective executive calendars and stakeholder engagements.
* Ensuring flawless coordination of leadership meetings, travel, and communications.
* Anticipating executive needs and resolving issues proactively.

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contract role  

  

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time\-off, payments, and work\-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de\-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third\-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave \& Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior L&D Coordinator
description:
Posted Wednesday, 23 September 2026 at 14:30
The Senior Learning \& Development Co\-Ordinator provides operational, systems and administrative support across all learning and development activities.
The role ensures learning programmes, systems, reporting and learner administration are delivered efficiently and accurately, providing an excellent experience for learners, managers and stakeholders. It plays a key role in maintaining learning governance, supporting programme delivery and enabling the wider Learning \& Development function to operate effectively.
Reporting into the Head of Learning \& Development, this role is a trusted operational partner, ensuring learning activities are coordinated, compliant and data driven.  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Administration \& Coordination**
* Coordinate learning activities, including course bookings, scheduling, learner communications and event logistics.
* Manage training calendars and ensure learning activities are delivered efficiently and on time.
* Maintain accurate learner records, attendance information and completion data.
* Support the administration of both virtual and face\-to\-face learning programmes.
* Act as the first point of contact for learning\-related queries.
  

**Apprenticeship Administration**
* Provide administrative support for apprenticeship programmes, including learner onboarding, documentation and record management.
* Maintain apprentice records and support compliance requirements.
* Liaise with providers, learners and managers to ensure programme administration is completed accurately and on time.
* Support reporting relating to apprenticeship activity and funding.
  

**Systems \& Data Management**
* Maintain learning systems and learning records, ensuring data quality and integrity.
* Support user management, course administration and system updates.
* Ensure learning information is accurate, accessible and compliant with organisational requirements.
* Support testing and implementation of system improvements where required.
  

**Reporting \& Insights**
* Produce regular reports and dashboards on learning activity, participation and completion.
* Monitor learning data and identify trends, gaps and areas for improvement.
* Support the preparation of management information for stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to business requirements.
  

**Supplier \& Financial Administration**
* Raise purchase orders and manage learning\-related invoices where needed.
* Support supplier administration and maintain accurate records.
* Track expenditure against learning budgets and report on spending activity.
* Assist with procurement and onboarding of learning providers where required.
  

**Learning Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Support audit, compliance and governance requirements relating to learning activity.
* Ensure processes, records and documentation are maintained to a high standard.
* Identify opportunities to improve learning administration, reporting and ways of working.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Learning \& Development function.
  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Essential**
* Experience providing administration or coordination support within HR, Learning \& Development or a similar function.
* Strong organisational and planning skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Experience producing reports and managing information.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel and business systems.
  

**Desirable**
* Experience supporting apprenticeship programmes.
* Experience using learning management systems.
* Experience supporting supplier or financial administration.
* Understanding of learning and development processes and practices.
* Power BI
  

**Behaviours \& Competencies:**
* Highly organised and detail oriented.
* Proactive and customer\-focused approach.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Collaborative working style.
* Adaptable and responsive to changing priorities.
* Commitment to delivering excellent service and learner experience.

title: GPO - Hire to Retire
description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.

  



Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Global Business Services**
----------------------------

Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).

  



Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.

**About the role**
------------------



As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.

  



This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.

  



Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred
**The skills for success**
--------------------------


* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration
**What we offer**
-----------------



With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.



We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

**Equality**
------------



We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.



All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Orcale HCM
description:
Oracle Cloud Workforce Scheduling Consultant – Job Description
We are seeking an experienced **Oracle Cloud Workforce Scheduling Consultant** to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Oracle Workforce Scheduling solutions. The consultant will partner with HR, Operations, Payroll, and business stakeholders to design and deploy scheduling processes that improve workforce utilization, compliance, and employee experience. The role requires hands\-on expertise in schedule patterns, shift planning, self\-scheduling, schedule publishing, absence integration, and Time \& Labor processes. The consultant will be responsible for requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, user training, and post\-go\-live support. Experience with Oracle Cloud HCM Workforce Scheduling, Time and Labor, Redwood experience, quarterly release testing, and troubleshooting complex scheduling scenarios is highly desirable. title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.


The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas.As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C CoE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function.Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.

**In this role, you will:**


The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions.Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery.Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities.Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness.Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected.Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR.Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas.Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery.Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team

**To be successful you will:**

**Knowledge \& Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions.Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making.Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes.Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation.Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans.Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities.Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders.Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment.Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

requests, employment confirmation letters, mass data updates, data corrections, and

and accuracy.  

Engage in HR system improvement projects or data migration activities.

Respond to data\-related queries from employees and management in a timely and

Provide support and guidance on data management best practices.

Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.**What we offer**

title: Onboarding Experience Partner
description:
**Company Description** **Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**  

Onboarding Experience Partner \- End\-to\-End Onboarding \& Day 1 Experience

  

We are looking for a proactive, empathetic, and detail\-oriented professional to serve as the single point of contact for candidates throughout their onboarding journey, from Interview Selection to successful Day 1 Onboarding and Reporting.


The role is responsible for managing the complete candidate onboarding lifecycle, including candidate engagement, offer acceptance support, onboarding coordination, Background Verification , Pre\-Medical management, Joining \& Relocation, Day 1 induction readiness, compliance governance, and employee experience management to ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging onboarding experience.


Key Responsibilities


End\-to\-End Onboarding Ownership

* Own the complete onboarding lifecycle from interview selection to Day 1 reporting.
* Serve as the dedicated SPOC for candidates throughout their onboarding journey.
* Proactively engage with candidates to drive readiness, confidence, and joining commitment.
* Ensure timely completion of all onboarding milestones and compliance requirements.


Candidate Experience \& Engagement

* Build meaningful relationships with candidates and provide personalized support.
* Drive a best\-in\-class onboarding experience that strengthens employer brand perception.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact candidate joining.
* Support offer acceptance, relocation, joining formalities, and pre\-joining queries.


Operational Excellence \& Governance

* Manage Background Verification , Pre\-Medical, documentation, and onboarding compliance processes.
* Track onboarding readiness and maintain governance dashboards and trackers.
* Monitor onboarding SLAs and ensure timely closure of activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to resolve bottlenecks and escalations.


Day 1 Experience Management

* Ensure complete Day 1 readiness, including system access, assets, workspace, and induction arrangements.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person Day 1 induction programs.
* Troubleshoot onboarding issues and drive timely resolution.
* Deliver a smooth and memorable first\-day employee experience.


Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, IT, Facilities, Security, Payroll, Finance, Admin, Vendors, and Business Leaders.
* Provide onboarding insights, updates, and risk assessments to stakeholders.
* Influence decisions and drive accountability across cross\-functional teams.


Continuous Improvement

* Identify process gaps and recommend automation and experience enhancement opportunities.
* Analyze onboarding metrics and trends to improve candidate conversion and onboarding effectiveness.
* Contribute to transformation and employee experience initiatives.


What We're Looking For


Essential Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and risk\-management capabilities.
* High attention to detail and process orientation.
* Passion for employee and candidate experience.


Preferred Experience

* Experience in End\-to\-End Onboarding, HR Operations, Candidate Experience, Recruitment Coordination, Employee Experience, or Shared Services Operations.
* Familiarity with BGV, Pre\-Medical, Documentation, Joining Formalities, Day 1 Induction, and HR compliance processes.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems and onboarding platforms.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.


Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.


Success in This Role Means

* High Interview\-to\-Join Conversion.
* Exceptional Candidate Experience Scores.
* Smooth Day 1 Readiness and Induction Delivery.
* Strong Stakeholder Satisfaction.
* Zero Compliance Gaps.
* Continuous Process Improvement and Automation Adoption.


Why Join Us?


This role provides a unique opportunity to directly influence how employees experience our organization from the very beginning. You will work with senior stakeholders, drive meaningful employee experience outcomes, lead critical onboarding initiatives, and play a pivotal role in shaping the future workforce experience.

**If you are passionate about people, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to create exceptional employee experiences at scale, we'd love to hear from you.**

 **Qualifications**  

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administrationor a related field.


3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.

 **Additional Information** **About the Department \- Human Resources**


The Human Resources department at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories is the organizational heartbeat, dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment for their 24,000\+ employees. As a well\-executed Human Resources (HR) team, we foster a positive and productive workplace. Effective HR practices are involved in recruiting and retaining top talent, providing comprehensive employee development programs, and ensuring fair and transparent policies. The robust HR department at Dr. Reddys is cultivating a culture of open communication, employee engagement, and diversity and inclusion. Moreover, it plays a crucial role in conflict resolution, fostering a healthy work environment and aligns organizational goals with the well\-being and professional growth of its employees, contributing significantly to overall company success.

**Benefits Offered**


At Dr. Reddy's, we actively help to catalyze your career growth and professional development through personalized learning programs. The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

**Our Work Culture**

title: Senior Learning Measurement Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**  

Job Purpose/Overview
  
  

The Senior Learning Measurement Analyst plays a pivotal role within Mars University’s Learning Measurement team, supporting the team by managing data, analysis, and reporting to evaluate the impact of learning programs. This role combines data transformation with visualization, applying analytical techniques where appropriate to create visibility to learning effectiveness and business value. The analyst collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, optimize reporting processes, and deliver insights that drive continuous improvement.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Operations Automation: Own the design and delivery of scalable reports and dashboards that support core learning operations (e.g., nominations, demand planning, evaluations). Continuously improve the data ecosystem by automating, standardizing, and optimizing reporting processes to enhance data usability and reduce manual effort.
* Program Portfolio Measurement: Support measurement efforts for priority learning programs, including KPI development, pre\- and post\-training assessment analysis, and summarizing key takeaways. Lead data support for new initiatives, such as pilots and new program launches.
* Insights Added Business Value: Take a consultative approach to data requests, helping stakeholders define their needs and shaping solutions that add strategic value. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or broken reports independently, setting up new methods when standard procedures do not apply.
* Mentorship Partnership: Serve as a technical mentor and thought partner for colleagues within the Learning Measurement team. Act as a key liaison with partners across MGS Learning, PO, and Functional teams to deliver accurate, relevant data and represent the Learning Measurement Strategy.
* Governance Documentation: Promote best practices in data protection, documentation, and quality control. Maintain clear documentation on how reports are built, where numbers come from, and what definitions are used.


Context and Scope
  
  

This role operates within the global Learning Measurement team, managing data projects from intake through to delivery with a high degree of autonomy. The analyst will partner closely with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across different segments of the business, translating technical findings into business\-relevant recommendations. The position requires a structured, problem\-solving mindset to uncover new and less obvious solutions that drive stakeholder impact.
  
  

Job Specifications/Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 years of experience in data and reporting
  
  

Knowledge / Experience
  
  

* Strong practical experience preparing, cleaning, and combining data from multiple sources (such as SQL, Excel, or automated data flows)
* Ability to run basic and intermediate statistical summaries (such as averages, standard deviations, distributions, and pre/post score comparisons) to find key insights and explain trends
* Proven ability to build and maintain clean, easy\-to\-use dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
* Ability to identify unusual data issues, find where things went wrong, and fix them independently
* Experience supporting junior colleagues, helping them troubleshoot data issues and checking work for quality and accuracy
* Experience finding manual or repetitive reporting steps and making them simpler or automated
* Clear verbal and written English skills to explain data findings simply to colleagues and stakeholders
* Experienced in digital fluency and demonstrated curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies including AI to drive innovation and continuous improvement
* Experience in working with learning or HR data (e.g., training completions, program effectiveness, people data) is preferred.

title: Manager - Executive Recruitments
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**The Opportunity**


We are looking for an exemplary Manager / Senior Manager \- Executive Recruitment (Technology) to drive leadership hiring across key technology functions. This role will focus on identifying, engaging, and hiring senior technology talent at the Director, Senior Director, and critical niche leadership levels.

  

The ideal candidate will bring strong executive recruiting expertise, deep understanding of technology talent markets, and the ability to partner with business leaders to deliver high\-quality leadership hiring outcomes. The role requires a blend of executive search, talent mapping, stakeholder management, and market intelligence capabilities.

  

**Leadership Hiring**


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for technology leadership and critical niche positions.
* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand talent requirements and develop hiring strategies.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of leadership talent across technology domains.
* Drive passive candidate engagement through direct sourcing, networking, and market research.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  

**Talent Mapping \& Market Intelligence**


* Conduct talent research and competitive intelligence to identify leadership talent across the market.
* Develop organizational and competitor mappings to support strategic hiring initiatives.
* Provide insights on talent availability, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
* Support workforce planning through external talent intelligence and succession insights.
  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with Technology Leaders, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership.
* Act as a trusted recruiting partner to hiring teams throughout the search process.
* Facilitate candidate assessments, interview debriefs, and selection decisions.
* Influence hiring outcomes through consultative and data\-driven recommendations.
  

**Sourcing Excellence**


* Leverage executive search methodologies and external networks to identify top talent.
* Create innovative sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-find technology leaders.
* Build long\-term relationships with passive candidates and industry networks.
* Maintain talent communities for recurring and future hiring needs.
  

**Process \& Governance**


* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and processes.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, pipeline quality, and hiring effectiveness.
* + Partner with recruitment operations and stakeholders to drive continuous process improvements.
	+ Support diversity\-focused hiring initiatives and inclusive recruiting practices.**Education**


	+ Bachelor's degree required.
	+ Postgraduate qualification/MBA preferred.**Experience**


	+ 12\-15 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Executive Search, or Leadership Hiring.
	+ Strong track record in hiring technology leaders across enterprise or consulting organizations.
	+ Experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, and niche technical leadership talent.
	+ Exposure to global hiring and stakeholder management preferred.

title: CTK Svc Associate
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  

  

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping  

  

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Advanced Degree
* Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
* Experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience owning end\-to\-end programs to drive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Windows, Word, Excel, MyTime (Kronos) and PowerPoint
* Experience in administrative tasks such as data entry, managing data driven report processes or processes
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
* 6\+ months of human resources experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
